scripts.text:
[KVM Officer]
Good Game.
May the glory of KVM be with you.
You aquire the winning points: 1
scripts.translation:
[KVM軍官]
打得漂亮。
願KVM的榮耀與您同在。
您獲得了1點勝利積分。

scripts.text:
[KVM Officer]
I am so sorry.
I wish you better luck next time.
You aquire the losing points: 0
scripts.translation:
[KVM軍官]
真遺憾，祝您下次好運。
您獲得了0點失敗積分。
